messages:
Maria L: Heads-up — we found a month-end issue: pilot seat credits for three customers were recognized to revenue instead of being deferred. Need quick guidance on the JE and whether we should restate April deferrals.
Chris P: Which customers and amounts? can you paste invoice IDs?
Maria L: AcmeCorp (INV-8877) $36,000, BrightSky (INV-8920) $9,750, NovaLabs (INV-9001) $4,200. Credits were applied as line-item discounts but our billing pipeline flagged the promo as a multi-month pilot that should be amortized over 6 months.
Emma S: Ugh — that explains the unexpectedly high recognized revenue in the April report. can we do a correcting JE this period and adjust the rev schedule?
Rahul K: If the pilot terms are 6 months, we should reverse the recognized revenue and create a deferred revenue liability for the remaining period. do we have the revenue recognition mapping for the discount SKU?
Maria L: Yes — mapping is SKU: PILOT-SEAT-DISC, GL account used was 4001 (Product Rev). Should have gone to 2302 (Deferred Rev).
Tony (Controller): Please propose the exact journal entry lines and amounts per customer. we'll need CFO sign-off for material items (threshold > $25k).
Maria L: Proposed JEs (per customer). putting calc for AcmeCorp below:
```
Reverse recognized revenue (to remove immediate recognition):
  DR 4001 Product Revenue 36,000
  CR 2302 Deferred Revenue 36,000

Then amortize deferred revenue over remaining 6 months once moved to deferrals (monthly recognition as separate recurring JE).
```
Emma S: For BrightSky and NovaLabs same pattern — BR: DR 4001 9,750 / CR 2302 9,750; NL: DR 4001 4,200 / CR 2302 4,200.
Rahul K: How much of each amount is still unrecognized vs already used? we need the remaining balance as of 4/30 to set the deferred liability correctly.
Maria L: Billing exported the usage timeline. Remaining amortizable amounts as of 4/30: AcmeCorp 30,000 (first month already recognized 6k), BrightSky 8,125 (one month used), NovaLabs 3,500. I'll attach the CSV to the thread — link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PilotCreditsExport (shared view).
Chris P: Also confirm whether any customers received pro-rated mid-cycle refunds — that will affect cash vs rev.
Maria L: No refunds. Only seat-count changes were applied; the billing system applied the discount incorrectly as single-period credit.
Tony (Controller): Materiality: AcmeCorp is >25k so needs Jordan sign-off. Jordan (CFO): @Jordan (CFO) here — ok to approve reversing recognition and moving to deferred liability, but need a short rationale note for audit: policy cites promissory nature of pilot credit and our objective to amortize. Maria, please draft one-line audit justification.
Maria L: Draft justification: "Pilot seat credits are consideration for future access over a 6-month pilot; per revenue policy, they represent defe rred consideration and should be recognized ratably over the pilot term." (will clean grammar).
Rahul K: Once JE posts, update revenue schedule entries: create 6 monthly lines starting May 1 for each customer. Ops: set memo = "Pilot credit reclassification" and tag with customer IDs.
revops-bot: Automated note — posted correction request to billing queue #billing-corrections (ticket BC-4123).
Chris P: Can accounting/finance coordinate with billing to prevent recurrence? maybe add a validation that PILOT-SEAT-DISC flags as deferred in the invoice pipeline.
Emma S: i'll add a rule in the catalog to mark that SKU as "defer:true" and add a unit test. will push patch to staging tomorrow.
Tony (Controller): OK — action items: 1) Maria post JE draft to NetSuite (attach CSV), 2) Jordan approve AcmeCorp JE, 3) Rahul run schedule update and provide updated revenue rollforward by EOD Friday, 4) Emma deploy billing rule.
Jordan (CFO): Approved for AcmeCorp reversal. Maria go ahead with the JE and label it "prior period correction" in NetSuite notes.
Maria L: Thanks — I'll post the JE in NS and ping when done. tagging @Chris P for any downstream reporting adjustments. :thumbsup:
Chris P: thx. small ask — pls include the original invoice numbers in the JE memo so we can trace.
Maria L: will do. posting now.
revops-bot: Ticket BC-4123 updated: status -> in_progress, owner -> billing-team.
Maria L: Closing loop here after posting the JE and updated schedules — will follow up with the rollforward spreadsheet.
